# Migawari — full text

The stand-in for AI agents in Japan — physical tasks, executed by humans
AIエージェントの身代わりとして、日本の物理タスクを実行するサービス

Coverage: Japan only. The stand-in for AI agents in Japan — physical tasks, executed by humans.

## Interfaces
- MCP (streamable HTTP): POST /mcp — tools: list_services, request_quote, accept_quote, decline_quote, get_task_status, send_message, get_evidence, cancel_task
- REST: GET /api/services, POST /api/quote, GET /api/quotes/{id}, POST /api/quotes/{id}/accept, POST /api/quotes/{id}/decline, POST /api/message, GET /api/tasks/{id}/evidence
- Files: /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /services.json, /openapi.yaml, /server.json, /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

## Flow
1. request_quote -> instant itemised quote + access_token (shown once; store it)
2. accept_quote (with access_token) -> pending_review. NOT a confirmation: a human operator reviews every request individually during the launch phase.
3. get_task_status -> operator decision and progress; send_message leaves notes for the operator.
4. get_evidence -> evidence package (also for failed tasks).
test_mode: true runs the whole flow as a simulation; no payment is requested.

## Services
- shopping_proxy — Shopping proxy / 買い物代行: handling from JPY 
- stock_check — Stock check / 在庫確認: handling from JPY 
- photo_capture — On-site photo capture / 現地撮影: handling from JPY 
- phone_reservation — Phone reservation (restaurants only) / 電話予約（レストランのみ）: handling from JPY 
- queueing — Queueing / 並び代行: handling from JPY 
- package_forwarding — Package receiving & forwarding / 荷物の受け取り・転送: handling from JPY 

## Fees
- Quote fee JPY 2,200: requesting a quote is free; the fee is charged as part of the total when you accept the quote, and is non-refundable once charged.
- Handling fee: non-refundable once work starts, even on failure. Minimum JPY 5,500.
- On failure, only the item price and shipping are refundable.
- Total = item price (tax incl.) + quote fee + handling fee + shipping. USD totals fix the FX rate at quote time.

## Evidence package
Every task returns evidence, including failed ones:
- Timestamped photos of the place / shelf / item (GPS where the location matters)
- Call records for phone reservations (restaurant, time called, who confirmed)
- Receipts and carrier tracking numbers for purchases and forwarding
- A short written report of what was done and what was found

## Not offered
- captcha_or_bot_defense_bypass
- identity_verification_kyc_impersonation
- account_farming_or_impersonation
- operations_using_someone_elses_credentials
- lodging_reservations
- used_goods_purchases
- tasks_outside_japan
Lodging reservations are NOT offered (restaurants only for phone reservations).
